blocks.title: Agent fleet orchestration loop — Intelligent Document Processing
blocks.note: Every iteration is replayable — the inputs, the policy state and the outputs — which is what turns an agent demo into an auditable system.

blocks.x: Every component in Intelligent Document Processing has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Intelligent Document Processing capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
